target.value: one creature/2 levels (maximum of 10) DESCRIPTION This spell functions like Poisonga , except it affects one creature per two levels (maximum of 10) within 50 feet of each other and the targets take 2d6 points of non-elemental damage + your caster modifier (Intelligence or Charisma) per round.
